observed_error: Model architectures ['NeurXDeepSeekV2ForCausalLM'] are not supported for now
root_cause: NeurX custom architecture registration was executed only in main process and not guaranteed in worker subprocesses before worker-side architecture resolution.
recommended_minimal_fix: Execute custom ModelRegistry registration at module import time in the NeurX registration module so spawned worker interpreters receive registration before LLM worker model resolution.
